categories.main_business_segments: Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of solar products including monocrystalline silicon rods, silicon wafers, solar cells, and PV modules. The company also develops and sells energy storage solutions and photovoltaic building-integrated products (BIPV). It maintains a vertically integrated production chain from silicon wafer production to module assembly, serving global PV power plant investors, developers, contractors, and distributed PV system end customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photovoltaic technologies such as N-type TOPCon solar cells, PERC, bifacial modules, half-cut cells, multi-busbar, and large-size wafer technologies. It has developed low-oxygen, low-concentric-circle N-type monocrystalline silicon technology and thin wafer slicing techniques. Production methods include vertical integration of silicon wafer, cell, and module manufacturing with a focus on automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D emphasizes high efficiency, low cost, and sustainable innovation, including perovskite tandem cells and recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinko Solar serves a diverse global customer base including PV power plant investors, developers, EPC contractors, distributors, and residential users. Its products are sold in over 190 countries and regions, covering major markets such as China, Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and emerging markets. The company targets large and medium-sized power projects through direct sales and smaller commercial and residential markets through distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant production and sales presence in China, Southeast Asia (including Malaysia and Vietnam), the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America. It has established overseas integrated production capacities exceeding 12GW and maintains a balanced global sales network with over 120 marketing branches and 35 service centers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinko Solar operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer covering upstream to downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. It produces silicon wafers, solar cells, and modules, positioning itself as a midstream to downstream player with control over core production processes and supply chain management. The company also engages in energy storage system production, complementing its PV module business.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on technological innovation with sustained high R&D investment targeting high-efficiency, low-cost, intelligent, and digitalized PV products. Key R&D directions include advancing N-type TOPCon cell technology, perovskite tandem cells, BIPV solutions, energy storage integration, and green recycling technologies. It also emphasizes global supply chain resilience, ESG improvements, and digital transformation of manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Jinko Solar generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic modules and related solar products. It also earns income from energy storage system sales and provides integrated clean energy solutions. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery based on sales contracts with global customers, including direct sales and distributor channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinko Solar is a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, ranking first in global PV module shipments in 2023. It competes with other major PV manufacturers such as LONGi, Trina Solar, and Canadian Solar. The company differentiates itself through advanced N-type TOPCon technology, vertical integration, global production footprint, and strong R&D capabilities, maintaining a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jinko Solar achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 118.7 billion, representing a 43.55% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose by 153.20% to RMB 7.44 billion. The company’s total assets reached RMB 132.1 billion, with a net asset growth of 28.72%. Cash flow from operating activities increased significantly by over 500%, reflecting strong sales growth and cash collection. The company continues to expand production capacity and invest heavily in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinko Solar emphasizes delivering high-efficiency, reliable, and cost-competitive photovoltaic products enabled by proprietary N-type TOPCon technology and vertical integration. Its products feature superior conversion efficiency, lower degradation, enhanced bifacial performance, and tailored solutions for diverse applications including BIPV and energy storage. The company’s global supply chain and ESG commitments further differentiate it by ensuring stable supply, compliance, and sustainability, providing customers with trusted clean energy solutions.
